title: Revisiting Noise in Natural Language Processing for Computational Social Science
reasoning: The thesis contains significant research components dedicated to evaluating human values, ethics, and religious traditions. Specifically, Chapter 5 investigates the Schwartz values framework (which includes 'Tradition' and 'Benevolence') and features a detailed case study on religious online communities (r/atheism, r/spirituality, and r/religion). Chapter 6 benchmarks Large Language Models using the Political Compass Test to uncover latent political and moral values.
